# iosxe_parameter_map_webauth_global (Resource)

This resource can manage the global web authentication parameter map (`parameter-map type webauth global`). WARNING: configuring a web authentication parameter map, including the global one, converts the device to IBNS 2.0 (new-style) session management. IOS-XE rewrites the authentication configuration to its control-policy equivalents (for example `authentication mac-move deny` becomes `access-session mac-move deny`, the default `ip admission` settings are removed and default `service-template` entries are added). This conversion cannot be undone from the CLI, and it also affects `iosxe_system` attributes such as `authentication_mac_move_*` and `access_session_mac_move_deny`. The global parameter map is a singleton that holds other web authentication settings, so destroying this resource only removes the configured attributes and leaves `parameter-map type webauth global` in place. Removing the attributes does not reverse the IBNS 2.0 conversion.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_parameter_map_webauth_global" "example" {
  virtual_ip_ipv4 = "192.0.2.1"
  virtual_ip_ipv6 = "2001:db8::1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `virtual_ip_ipv4` (String) Virtual IPv4 address.
- `virtual_ip_ipv6` (String) Virtual IPv6 address.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_parameter_map_webauth_global.example ""
```
